# The Descended from the Queen fixtures as a deck

Every card note in this folder, the table note's three rows included;
`Question-17` says `language: en` and stays out. Tarot cards, cut marks,
fronts only — with `side: front` on the block no back page is composed.

```cardsmith-deck
system: dftq
card-type: prompt
card-languages: de
side: front
paper-size: A4 portrait
```
